transcript.text: Oh gosh, how did we get into this mess? Let's take a look. This is Minnesota Safety. Police are already unseen due to several crashes when this black hatchback middle of your screen is going to go full Winter Olympics on us with a 180-degree slide, and they landed pretty decently without running into anyone. Police and tow trucks clear up this first series of crashes that black SUV is going to get out of there, but it's not over. We're going to have another half dozen cars involved in this one. in just a matter of minutes and it starts with this gray Jeep. It continues to be a very cold and snowy winter in Minnesota with an emphasis on the cold. We get a little bit of snow every week, but the temperatures are the real story with daily temps getting regularly below zero and a high temp of maybe four to seven degrees on most days, which makes salt largely ineffective and creates situations where roads frequently freeze with little notice and the ice can be pretty hard to see. We had one car that slid off while the police were on scene. Now we have two more, each off on each side of the road. Take a look at this black SUV, which wildly overcorrected and makes a beeline for the one car that's off on the left side of the road. And we try not to give drivers too hard of a time, but we know that cars are off the road here. The driver got out and sat down right basically what I'd call the line of fire. This red SUV is going to be the fourth or fifth vehicle off-road and thankfully goes to the right avoiding the pedestrian in the center median who has their back to traffic a cv is going to roll over and that is thankfully the most gentle rollover i've ever seen this is a minnesota so one vehicle is going to stop and check on them and looks like we've got one two maybe three people coming in there tell your folks i says hey okay police arriving on scene but before they do we've got yet another car this time a gray sedan that's going to slide off and good awareness by the trucker watch this to avoid a collision which really would have made a mess of that situation police wisely go over to the right side of the road to check on that roll over first as part of a triage procedure ambulance now arriving on scene within a couple minutes thankfully it seems we really got pretty lucky under the circumstances and for what it's worth we really think this is a pretty vulnerable position on the left there sitting down on the side of the freeway in the median where cars are actively sliding off like subscribe and share We've got a lot of content like this and a whole lot more on the way.
